text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival has arrived. 
This year's most anticipated main 
attraction is—

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan
text_block_list.text:
C-C.B.! Eeeek, this is my first time 
seeing her so close up!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd get to see Ace run again...! 
Fan Appreciation Day is the absolute 
best!"

It was an exhibition match featuring a 
handpicked roster of competitors.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The sky is clear, attendance is great. The 
crowd is thoroughly warmed up.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh!

The corners of Sirius Symboli's mouth curl 
up. —Yes, she had been hatching a plan 
ever since the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A massive number of visitors come to the 
Fan Appreciation Festival every year.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"If there's one thing we can expect from 
that— it's naturally the spread of 
information on social media."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Enter the event that's bound to draw the 
most attention, and soak up even more of 
the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Let more people know that she has her 
sights set on overseas challenges."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In short, it's planting vital seeds for 
the future.

Just as planned, the exhibition match was 
buzzing with immense excitement even 
before it started.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: And, Sirius! Thanks for inviting me today.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm really happy. I've wanted to have a 
proper run with you at least once.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I saw the Arima Kinen. Made me realize an 
unbelievable monster had just moved up to 
the Senior division.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'm feeling fired up today...! Let's do 
this, Sirius!"

Yes, wearing a spirited smile was a 
hot-blooded Umamusume from the 
countryside—

The first Japanese runner to conquer the 
Japan Cup, breathing fresh wind into the 
Japanese Umamusume world— Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Much obliged. I'm glad to be working with 
you folks as well.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, whoa! C.B., Ace, and Sirius Symboli 
are talking about something over there!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—...However, before we begin this match, 
let me say one thing.

Sirius Symboli raised her voice, as if 
deliberately stirring up the crowd's 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I am an Umamusume who reigns at the 
pinnacle of the world!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I've got no plans to settle for staying 
domestic. I'll trample over every 
Umamusume in the world—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'll shine under the skies of 
Longchamp!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't forget that. I'd hate to be 
treated the same as any run-of-the-mill 
Umamusume."

At those powerful words, the entire stands 
fall completely silent. And then, Mr. C.B. 
and Katsuragi Ace—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are set firmly on the world— Not 
on Japanese Umamusume, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Quite the stylish declaration of war 
you've given me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry, but getting taunted only fires me 
up. Heh, let's do this...!

The cheerful atmosphere from earlier 
vanished, replaced by the sharp, piercing 
gaze she cast at her.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Ha...! Their spirit is on a whole 
different level. As expected of the 
legends who built an entire era.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, Sirius Symboli had her sights 
set on overseas challenges...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“Still, Japanese Umamusume don't stand a 
chance overseas, right? Traveling abroad 
is tough, and the environment's totally 
different.”

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
For now, aren't we seeing what she's made 
of today...? Just how far she can go 
against those two.

Amidst the mounting spotlight— the 
exhibition match began!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, the pack approaches the final 
corner! In the lead is Katsuragi Ace— 
Sirius Symboli pushes forward from 
mid-pack!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Raaaaaaahhh!

Sensing the movement—Katsuragi Ace kicks 
off the turf and bursts into sudden 
acceleration.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, right here!

Wearing a serene smile, Mr. C.B. surges 
forward from behind like a gale, rapidly 
closing the distance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...! Ha, now this is getting interesting!

text_block_list.name: 3 people
text_block_list.text: Uraaaahhhhh! Haaaaahhhhh! Uwoooohhhhh!

Just before the wire, three run neck and 
neck! Amidst roaring strides, they surge 
past the finish line—and the winner is...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: It's Mr. C.B.——!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Kh!! Haa, haa, ...haa...! Haa!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it. —Ah, those legs truly live up 
to the rumors.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap!! No way! I'm so glad I got that 
on video!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Sirius Symboli! You really kept 
right on those two's heels!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that was incredible! I see, so she's 
aiming for overseas races...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ace. You know, I was thinking of 
taking it easy for a while...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: My heart truly leaped with joy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Can't blame ya. I feel the exact same 
way."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...The seeds have sprouted, at least.

Though she lost the race, she succeeded in 
planting seeds across all fronts— and so 
concluded the Fan Appreciation Festival.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Sirius Symboooooliiiii!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Kh!! Haa, haa, ...haa...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it. ...Ha, hahaha! You've gotta be 
kidding me...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: But..., I got it...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~~?! For real?! I'm so glad I was 
recording a video!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she beat both of them! A 
real monster just moved up to the Senior 
class!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Talking big about reaching the top 
overseas... Maybe I should believe in 
her...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ace. To be honest, I was thinking it 
might be time for me to step down from the 
front lines.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: My heart truly leaped with joy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Can't blame ya. I feel the exact same 
way."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Next time, I definitely won't forgive 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hah, what a thrill. Even in defeat, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: No, but still—it sprouted.

Having successfully sown seeds in every 
direction— such was how the Fan 
Appreciation Festival concluded.

The race footage captured that day became 
a hot topic on social media and was shared 
widely.

text_block_list.name: Comment A
text_block_list.text:
"Declaring it so clearly and actually 
winning... That's so cool."

text_block_list.name: Comment B
text_block_list.text:
"Taking on the world, huh... I haven't 
heard of many success stories, but... I 
really want Sirius Symboli to do her 
best."

Through the Fan Appreciation Festival, 
many people have started paying close 
attention to Sirius Symboli's future.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Either way, the real showdown is next.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This is the grand stage of the Takarazuka 
Kinen... Be a good girl and watch closely.
